company.shortDescription: Ladder Therapeutics is a biotechnology research company.
company.description: Ladder Therapeutics aims to illuminate the dark genome by combining machine learning, new chemistry, and RNA biology. They are developing an in-silico and in-vitro platform for the discovery of small-molecule RNA modulators. They are inquisitive, nimble, and fearless, breaking new territory and expanding quickly. Join us in improving things and becoming a part of the journey.

aiResearchSummary.text: Ladder Therapeutics is researching molecular biology methods to map RNA binding protein interaction sites on RNA. The work, described in the title on methods and an abstract detailing determining the location of binding sites on RNA nucleic acid, focuses on techniques to identify where specific proteins associate with RNA sequences. Overall, Ladder Therapeutics is developing analytical platforms for RNA protein binding site localization.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Ladder Therapeutics combines Predicting RNA Binding Molecules Using Machine Learning with AI Enabled RNA Drug Discovery.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
